reviews.title: Good Case
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] Good case, lots of cable management space, easy to assemble my pc in, didnt have any hassles with it.

reviews.title: Good Case
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] Overall great case and looks amazing. Only problem I had was with plugging in case cables and the cpu cable because of the tight space but overall easy to build in.

reviews.title: Nice box
reviews.comment: Nice tower. Easy to work with. The fans provide plenty of cooling, but you could add another fan. Could put about any GPU in here. There's plenty of room.
reviews.author: DavidJ

reviews.title: Decent case, missing items.
reviews.comment: Seems like a good case. Low rating because it was missing 2 out of 3 fans, while waiting for the rest of the parts i missed the return window an was told my only option was to bring in the case to see if a manager would get a replacement for me still. Already have the pc built and don't want to take it apart, was hoping i could just get the missing fans i paid for but guess not.
